backgrounds.name: Captain's Deck
backgrounds.visual_review: Glossy rounded cartoon scenery with clear center; reviewed before export.
backgrounds.generation_prompt: Reference is approved Candy game artwork: MATCH its cute cartoon style, not its candy subject. Create ONE Pirate stage 2: Captain's Deck. Broad open pale honey wooden ship deck, rounded polished railings only along edges, coiled rope at far corners, sails high overhead and turquoise sea beyond, central deck entirely clear. Strongly stylized glossy chubby toy-world cartoon: exaggerated rounded shapes, bulbous lavender rocks, chunky curved playful architecture, huge shiny emerald palm leaves, soft puffy clouds, smooth turquoise water drawn as stylized swirls. Candy-bright colors and polished cartoon highlights. NO realism, gritty textures, naturalistic wood grain or photographic water. Wide quiet pale central area 70% width/65% height for maze overlay, scenery concentrated on far edges. No characters, text, collectibles, UI, circles, grid or baked-in maze. Single 16:9 scene ideally 3840x2160.
